name: Precolumbian Chiefdom Settlements with Stone Spheres of the Diquís
description: In southern Costa Rica's Diquís Delta, four archaeological sites preserve the remains of chiefdoms that thrived between AD 500 and 1500. Their stars are the nearly perfect stone spheres, from about 0.7 to 2.57 metres across, still lying where they were placed. Nobody knows exactly why they were made, and thick layers of sediment protected them from looters for centuries.
